description: An intro in the style of neofetch and link badges, from what you type in. Nothing to connect

links_brand_colors.label: Brand colors
links_brand_colors.tooltip: Icons of known sites in their brand color (LinkedIn blue, YouTube red…). Off, every icon takes the theme's accent color.

links_items.description: Up to 8 links. Only the address is required.
links_items.label: Links
links_items.tooltip: An address can be a site (https://… or just example.com) or an email (you@example.com). The icon and the text are picked from the address unless you choose them.

links.description: A row of buttons for your site, profiles and email. Each one can also be its own image and link
links.name: Link badges

neofetch_fields.description: Up to 10 lines of Label: value
neofetch_fields.label: Lines
neofetch_fields.tooltip: Each line is a label and its value, such as Location: Brazil or Stack: TypeScript · React. A value too long for the card ends in an ellipsis.

neofetch_image.description: An https:// address of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image, up to 400 KB
neofetch_image.label: Picture URL
neofetch_image.tooltip: The image is downloaded once per generation and embedded in the SVG, because a README cannot load images from inside an image. https://github.com/<you>.png works. Leave it empty for no picture.

neofetch_show_cursor.label: Show prompt at the end
neofetch_show_cursor.tooltip: Terminal style only: a last prompt with a block cursor, which blinks when animations are on.

neofetch_show_palette.label: Show color palette
neofetch_show_palette.tooltip: A row of the card theme's colors under the lines, like the color blocks neofetch prints.

neofetch_title.description: Shown as user@host, like a terminal prompt
neofetch_title.label: Title
neofetch_title.tooltip: The part before the @ and the part after it are drawn in the theme's accent color. Without an @, the whole title is.

neofetch.description: Your picture next to a user@host title and the lines you write, like neofetch prints them
neofetch.name: Neofetch intro
